ambiguity_effects.explain: Grammatically 'that mentions the rollback plan' sits next to 'issue', but pragmatically the comment is what is edited/approved. Under issue-reading, i-lat description does not mention a rollback plan, so no comment would qualify; under comment-reading, only comments whose own body mentions it qualify.

turn2.naturalness_note: Reads as an ordinary workplace request: issue by title, comment by author/level/content, plain-language edit action. No IDs, URLs, or test-only hints.
